user.title: Log in with your MijnKNLTB account
user.description: The account you use on mijnknltb.toernooi.nl. Any KNLTB member's account can follow other players. MijnKNLTB has no tokens, so the password is stored in Home Assistant to log in again when the session ends (every 7 days).

data_description.login: Your MijnKNLTB login name, member number (bondsnummer) or email address.

own_profile.title: Follow your own profile?
own_profile.description: This account belongs to **{name}**. You can add other players later with **Add player**.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: MijnKNLTB no longer accepts the password of {login}. Enter the (new) password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MijnKNLTB. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data_description.query: The player's name, or part of it (at least 3 characters).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MijnKNLTB. Try again later.
error.no_players_found: No player found (or all of them are already followed). Try another spelling or part of the name.

abort.account_not_loaded: The account is not working at the moment (see its status). Fix that first.
abort.no_own_profile: This account has no player profile of its own.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach MijnKNLTB. Try again later.

auth_failed.message: MijnKNLTB refused the login; log in again.

markup_changed.message: A MijnKNLTB page could not be read; the site may have changed ({error}).

markup_changed.title: Tenniscompetitie cannot read MijnKNLTB
markup_changed.description: Some MijnKNLTB pages ({pages}) no longer have the layout this version of the integration reads, so some sensors are unavailable. Update Tenniscompetitie in HACS; if there is no newer version yet, please report it in the issues.
